title: Pseudo-Dirac dark matter with a heavy Z': coupling relations, relic density and the LZ event without a dark photon
question: Can a heavy U(1)' gauge boson (B-L or leptophobic U(1)_B) coupling quarks to a pseudo-Dirac fermion reproduce the LZ event at delta = 300-380 keV while giving Omega h^2 = 0.12, respecting dijet/dilepton limits, a charge-2q_chi scalar origin of delta, the CMB bound (P025) and the exothermic floor (P026)?
headline_result: LZ fixes G = g_chi g_N/m_Z'^2 = 1.42e-7 (300 keV) to 2.0e-5 GeV^-2 (380 keV) at 1 TeV; since scattering and s-wave chi1 chi2 -> Z'* -> ff both scale as G^2, a heavy thermal Z' gives a coupling-independent 0.095 (B-L)/0.31 (U(1)_B) events at 300 keV (one event only at delta = 242/272 keV; 0.003 at the 2m_chi resonance), so the event requires m_Z' <~ m_chi with chi chi -> Z'Z' setting the relic (g_chi ~ 0.7) and LZ fixing g_q ~ 0.02-0.03; within recalled dijet ceilings thermal U(1)_B reaches delta <= 343/319/277 keV (m_Z' = 0.5/1/>=2 TeV), B-L only 298/231 keV; P021's 365-385 keV corner is unreachable; chi2 decays in 1.7e10 s (B-L) and CMB annihilation is 3-5% of Planck
model_or_mechanism: pseudo-Dirac Dirac fermion split by charge-2q_chi scalar S, heavy U(1)' Z' with B-L or baryonic charges; off-diagonal vector current -> inelastic isoscalar O1 (c_p = c_n = G) and s-wave chi1 chi2 -> Z'* -> ff coannihilation plus chi chi -> Z'Z'; Gondolo-Gelmini thermal average + Boltzmann ODE; recalled dijet/dilepton ceilings; Hulthen Sommerfeld; chi2 -> chi1 nu nubar via Z' (B-L) or Z-Z' mixing
confidence: medium - LZ couplings validated against P011/P021 and relic machinery against the ODE (0.97-1.02), but the viability map rests on recalled collider ceilings
